contract_answer.question: Does replacing Relative Huber with standardized-target MSE change the three-split MAPE by at least 0.008 on the frozen NA-E009 recipe?
contract_answer.conclusion: Direct recomputation of all 600 selected-checkpoint predictions gives split-2021 MAPE 0.072665, Acc@15 0.948333, RMSE 15.6134 cycles, and bias +4.1788 cycles, versus NA-E009 at 0.099874, 0.743333, 22.5282, and -15.9075. Across NA-E029/030/031, however, MSE is 0.106198 +/- 0.029159 MAPE versus Relative Huber 0.108654 +/- 0.008549: the -0.002456 difference is inside the registered +/-0.008 band, so the family result is TIED rather than BETTER. The existing split-level decision is KEEP.

main_symptom: MSE produces a large split-2021 gain but that gain does not replicate: the three-split mean is only 0.00246 lower than Relative Huber and its sample standard deviation rises from 0.00855 to 0.02916.

causes.class: evaluation variance: six validation cells per split make the apparent MSE benefit split-dependent
supporting_evidence: validation_predictions.npz::cell_id has 6 unique cells and 600 prefix samples
MSE split MAPEs are 0.072665/0.120335/0.125594, while Relative Huber is 0.099874/0.116952/0.109135
MSE MAPE sample std is 0.029159 versus 0.008549 for Relative Huber
contradicting_evidence: On split 2021, MSE improves MAPE by 0.02721, Acc@15 by 0.20500, and RMSE by 6.91 cycles
All predictions and training diagnostics are finite
causes.interpretation: The split-2021 improvement is real for these six cells, but the opposite direction on the other two locked splits makes it insufficient evidence for a general loss advantage.

causes.class: objective tradeoff: MSE changes error weighting and bias without a consistent prefix-band gain
supporting_evidence: Relative Huber parent bands are 0.1221/0.0951/0.0927/0.0921/0.1084, so MSE worsens 01-10 but improves all later bands on this split
Prediction bias shifts from -15.9075 cycles to +4.1788 cycles while spread remains compressed at 0.7421 of target spread
contradicting_evidence: The three-split average late 76-100 band improves from 0.08644 to 0.07853
Three-split RMSE improves from 29.3662 to 27.6806 cycles
causes.interpretation: MSE corrects the strong negative bias on split 2021 and helps its later prefixes, but average early-prefix bands do not improve and the bias changes sign across splits, consistent with an unstable weighting tradeoff rather than a robust mechanism.
missing_evidence: A larger Na-ion validation cohort would be needed to estimate loss-by-cell interactions precisely
